propositions: A write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changed on one adapter (lib, CLI, MCP) without matching updates to sibling adapters, introducing divergence risk
The code-review gate lacks a static surface-parity overlay to flag such divergences at review time before code lands
The overlay must be glob-triggered on the three write-surface adapters and wired into round_a and round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched
The overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergence and adapter-bound non-caller-visible params
The base-reviewer overlay catalog must enumerate surface-parity and stay in lockstep with OVERLAY_IDS via test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids
reviewers/index.json must remain unchanged (overlays excluded from catalog); drift gate passes as a no-op
